title: Lags Extremely & Overheats Very Much.
body: I have an iPad Air 6th Gen M2, barely two months old. Whenever I use the notes app, i barely write for fifteen minutes before my iPad overheats seriously, to the point the screen feels like it’s burning. The battery drains extremely fast as well, sometimes losing 50% in 3 minutes. The writing starts to lag, with words appearing after i have already finished writing with the pen. This isn’t feasible at all. I am on the latest iOS update (iOS 18.2). This needs to be sorted out ASAP.

title: Glitches up
body:
In 16.2 the app causes the iPad to heat up. The lag when writing is annoying. This lag sometimes doesn’t even translate to a written note. It could sometimes flash notes previously written in a blank page, overlaying wheat you’re trying to write that just won’t be written. 
The new additions, fountain pen and what not are fantastic. And I am looking forward to using them in a more bug free update.

title: iPadOS 16 notes bug
body:
To whomever this may concern,
I updated my iPad to iPadOS 16 2 days ago and my notes app has been malfunctioning ever since.it keeps on shutting down unexpectedly and my notes aren't being written at the rate I'm writing them (the handwriting is lagging). I'm a university student and this is very important to me.

title: iOS and PadOS 15 has made app unusable
body: This used to be one of the reasons why I remained in the apple ecosystem. You would put down notes and rely on it to sync across all your apple devices. With the latest updates, I have lost over 600 notes that were on my iPads and iPhones. The only place where they still are is on the macbook. I have done everything they advise to do from logging out icloud on all devices to hard resetting the devices all to no avail. In short, Notes has simply stopped working. All the devices are running the latest software updates and versions of Notes but interestingly Quick Notes only appear on some and not all devices yet its the same version of the app with the same exact settings!
author: antowandera

title: Lags too much
body: I have been using the notes app for my university notes. Lately, the app lags too much, shuts without warning. Occasionally, I have ended up losing my notes that hadn’t been saved in such instances. It is useable only to some extent. For students, I would recommend the paid applications since they seem to work much better and your work won’t varnish.
